top_signals.title: Inflation on many everyday items was entirely due to tariffs, NY Fed says
top_signals.summary: Tariffs added 2.9 percentage points to inflation in 67 categories of goods by February 2026, researchers at the New York Federal Reserve found.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
